raw.description: Adjust Ad Spend API: send a partner cost engagement (CPC / CPI / CPE / CPM / CPA / flat). Wraps POST https://app.adjust.com/cost. Adjust accepts events up to 7 days after the engagement. Requires scope: write:campaigns.

action.description: Ad Spend operation. SEND_AD_SPEND = post one cost engagement. SEND_AD_SPEND_BULK = fan-out up to 100 events; partial-success aware (returns per-event status).

label.description: Adjust connection label (the slug shown in the integrations drawer). Pick which token to use.

payload.description: For SEND_AD_SPEND: { event: { cost_type, cost_currency, cost_amount, cost_id (12-256 chars), tag? } }. For SEND_AD_SPEND_BULK: { events: AdjustCostEvent[] }.

raw.description: Adjust App Automation API: programmatic app creation + channel setup + ticket polling + multi-app event upsert + app settings + SDK-secret rotation. Wraps https://automate.adjust.com/app-automation/. Most reads require read:accounts, writes require write:campaigns, and SDK-secret rotation requires admin access in Adjust.

action.description: App Automation operation. CREATE_APP / UPDATE_APP = manage app definitions; returns ticket_token to poll. GET_APP / GET_APP_BY_STORE_ID / LIST_AUTOMATION_APPS = read app metadata. GET_JOB_STATUS = poll a ticket_token until completed/failed. UPSERT_EVENTS = create/update events on multiple apps in one call. GET_APP_SETTINGS = full read of an app's automation config. REVOKE_OUTDATED_SECRETS / REVOKE_SECRET / REACTIVATE_SECRET = SDK-secret rotation (admin scope).

label.description: Adjust connection label (the slug shown in the integrations drawer). Pick which token to use.

payload.description: Action-specific body. See AdjustAppCreateRequest, AdjustAppUpdateRequest, AdjustEventsUpsertRequest, and the channel_setup partner table in shared/platforms/adjust/types.ts.

raw.description: Adjust Campaign API: partners + trackers + sublinks management. Wraps https://api.adjust.com/public/v2/. Cursor-paginated lists; create/update returns the tracker payload. Reads require read:reporting; writes require write:campaigns.

action.description: Campaign API operation. LIST_PARTNERS = available networks (cursor paginated). LIST_TRACKERS = network-level trackers for an app. LIST_TRACKER_CHILDREN = sublinks (campaign / adgroup / creative). CREATE_TRACKER = create a tracker or sublink. UPDATE_TRACKER = patch partner_id / cost_data_enabled / name.

label.description: Adjust connection label (the slug shown in the integrations drawer). Pick which token to use.

payload.description: Action-specific body. LIST_TRACKERS: { appToken, limit?, cursor? }. LIST_TRACKER_CHILDREN: { appToken, linkToken, limit?, cursor? }. CREATE_TRACKER: { appToken, request: { name, parent_token? } }. UPDATE_TRACKER: { appToken, linkToken, patch: { partner_id?, cost_data_enabled?, name? } }.

raw.description: Adjust TrueLink (Deep Link Generator): create / get / update / quota / bulk-create. Wraps https://automate.adjust.com/engage/deep-links/. Reads require read:reports; writes require write:campaigns.

action.description: TrueLink operation. CREATE / CREATE_BULK = generate short links (max 100 per bulk). GET = fetch metadata by short_token + app_token. UPDATE = patch redirect / fallback / deep_link_path. GET_QUOTA = check daily TrueLink quota.

label.description: Adjust connection label (the slug shown in the integrations drawer). Pick which token to use.

payload.description: Action-specific body. CREATE: { request: AdjustDeepLinkRequest }. CREATE_BULK: { requests: AdjustDeepLinkRequest[] }. GET: { shortToken, appToken }. UPDATE: { shortToken, patch }.

raw.description: List all connected Adjust accounts and the apps each token can see. Use this first to discover labels (per-token connection slug) and app_tokens before calling other Adjust tools. Mirrors how list_workspace_assets works for the ad platforms. Requires scope: read:accounts.

include_disconnected.description: Include connections marked inactive and apps the user toggled off. Default: false (active only).

raw.description: Adjust Reports Service: filters, events, JSON report, pivot. Wraps GET https://automate.adjust.com/reports-service/{filters_data,events,report,pivot_report}. CSV / Parquet exports are intentionally not exposed via MCP because the response payload is binary. Requires scope: read:reports.

action.description: Reports Service operation. LIST_FILTERS = enumerate apps / countries / partners / metrics / etc. LIST_APPS = shorthand for filters with required_filters=apps. LIST_EVENTS = list custom events on given apps. GET_REPORT = JSON report grouped by dimensions. GET_PIVOT = JSON report with per-dimension totals. CSV / Parquet downloads are intentionally excluded from MCP — use the web app.

label.description: Adjust connection label (the slug shown in the integrations drawer). Pick which token to use.

payload.description: Action-specific body. LIST_FILTERS: { requiredFilters, section?, search? }. LIST_EVENTS: { appTokens, datePeriod }. GET_REPORT / GET_PIVOT: { request: { dimensions, metrics, date_period, ... } }.
